description: Flat metadata schema for individual stool microbiome sequencing records from patients undergoing antibiotic treatment, capturing participant context, stool collection details, medication exposure, and laboratory/sequencing protocols relevant to microbial diversity and antibiotic resistance analysis.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or sample.

study_subject_id.descr: De-identified participant identifier linking repeated samples from the same patient, if applicable.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the stool sample or sequencing specimen.

collection_date.descr: Date the stool sample was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Time of sample collection, if available (HH:MM or ISO 8601 time).

sample_type.descr: Biological sample type; expected value: stool.

specimen_body_site.descr: Anatomical site of origin; expected value: feces/gut/stool.

participant_age.descr: Participant age at sampling, in years.

participant_sex.descr: Participant sex or sex assigned at birth, if recorded; e.g., female, male, intersex, unknown.

participant_bmi.descr: Body mass index at or near sampling, in kg/m^2, if available.

health_status.descr: Overall patient health status at sampling; e.g., healthy, hospitalized, outpatient, ICU, immunocompromised.

clinical_condition.descr: Primary clinical condition or indication for antibiotic treatment; free-text or controlled term.

disease_diagnosis.descr: Relevant diagnosed disease or comorbidity affecting gut microbiota; free-text or coded term.

antibiotic_exposure.descr: Whether the participant was receiving antibiotic treatment at the time of sample collection.

antibiotic_name.descr: Name of the antibiotic medication used at or before sampling; use generic name when possible.

antibiotic_class.descr: Antibiotic class, if known; e.g., beta-lactam, fluoroquinolone, macrolide, tetracycline.

antibiotic_dose.descr: Antibiotic dose administered, in standardized unit if available (e.g., mg, mg/kg).

antibiotic_dose_unit.descr: Unit for antibiotic dose; e.g., mg, mg/kg, g, mL.

antibiotic_route.descr: Route of antibiotic administration; e.g., oral, intravenous, intramuscular, topical.

antibiotic_end_date.descr: Date antibiotic treatment ended or was last administered (YYYY-MM-DD).

days_on_antibiotic_at_sampling.descr: Number of days from antibiotic start to sample collection.

other_medication_use.descr: Whether other medications were being used at sampling that may affect the gut microbiota.

medication_list.descr: List of other relevant medications or supplements taken near sampling, if available.

probiotic_use.descr: Whether the participant was using probiotics at the time of sampling.

prebiotic_use.descr: Whether the participant was using prebiotics or dietary fiber supplements at the time of sampling.

dietary_pattern.descr: General diet pattern at sampling; e.g., omnivore, vegetarian, vegan, enteral nutrition, restricted diet.

recent_diet_change.descr: Whether there was a recent change in diet before sampling.

diet_notes.descr: Free-text notes on diet, fasting status, or nutrition relevant to microbiome composition.

stool_consistency.descr: Stool form or consistency; e.g., Bristol stool scale or descriptive category.

stool_collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the stool sample; e.g., home kit, clinic-collected, rectal swab substitute not recommended.

collection_container_type.descr: Type of container or kit used for sample collection and transport.

collection_time_to_processing_hours.descr: Time from collection to nucleic acid extraction or stabilization processing, in hours.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the stool sample was stored before extraction, in degrees Celsius.

preservative_used.descr: Whether a preservative or stabilization buffer was used during collection or transport.

preservative_name.descr: Name of preservative or stabilization reagent, if used.

nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted; expected values may include DNA, RNA, total nucleic acid.

extraction_method.descr: Nucleic acid extraction protocol or kit name used for sample processing.

extraction_kit_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer of the nucleic acid extraction kit, if applicable.

extraction_date.descr: Date nucleic acid extraction was performed (YYYY-MM-DD).

dna_yield_ng.descr: Yield of extracted DNA in nanograms, if measured.

dna_concentration_ng_per_ul.descr: DNA concentration in ng/µL, if measured.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for sequencing library construction.

library_prep_pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR amplification cycles used during library preparation, if applicable.

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Average library insert size in base pairs, if measured or specified.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument platform; e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NextSeq, NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore, PacBio.

sequencing_technology.descr: Sequencing technology used; e.g., short-read, long-read, paired-end, single-end.

sequencing_mode.descr: Sequencing run mode; e.g., metagenomic shotgun, 16S amplicon, metatranscriptomic.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for each read, if applicable.

paired_end.descr: Whether sequencing was performed as paired-end reads.

indexing_strategy.descr: Indexing or barcode strategy used to multiplex samples, if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of raw reads generated for the sample.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier of the sequencing run or flow cell, if available.

basecalling_version.descr: Basecalling software or pipeline version, if applicable.

quality_control_passed.descr: Whether the sample passed sequencing and library quality-control thresholds.

qc_metrics.descr: Free-text or compact summary of key QC metrics, such as contamination, read quality, or host read fraction.

host_dna_depletion_used.descr: Whether a host DNA depletion step was applied before sequencing.

host_dna_depletion_method.descr: Method used to reduce host DNA, if applicable.

resistance_gene_focus.descr: Whether the downstream analysis specifically targeted antimicrobial resistance genes.

resistance_gene_database.descr: Reference database used for resistance gene annotation, if applicable.

microbial_diversity_analysis_planned.descr: Whether microbial diversity analysis was intended or performed on this record.

analysis_notes.descr: Free-text notes on preprocessing, contamination concerns, or analysis-relevant deviations from protocol.
